definitions.businessWall: First formal task-URL-bearing API invocation through the last non-cleanup business/evidence API acknowledgement. Includes elapsed model thinking, tool round trips, errors and legal alternatives between endpoints; excludes preparation, begin and cleanup. Independently unlogged report-file write completion is unknown. Not a driver/model speed benchmark.
definitions.unknown: JSON null means unknown/not measured unless the adjacent basis says not started/not applicable; never inferred by subtraction.
definitions.status: Provisional until a verified final audit supplies an explicit final verdict. Original failed attempts cannot be upgraded by later recovery.
definitions.cleanup: Reported separately; independent timing supersedes solver-observed or SDK-only durations.

boundaries: OBU isolated Chromium/actual Go host/test Native Port and Codex IAB are different installation conditions.
OBU bridge tool round trips, formal API calls, model tool calls and transport RPCs are distinct.
No independent native OS foreground observation; zero browser focus events cannot prove no OS foreground changes.
Two rounds do not establish speed equivalence, statistical significance, cross-platform coverage, ordinary Edge acceptance or full Codex parity.
This index is an offline evidence summary, not proof of a new execution; originals remain local.

limits: Frozen24 task attempts; first attempts and unsupported/errors retained. No fresh-key reruns.

Formal API counts and wall intervals are not a model reasoning-speed or driver benchmark; top-level tool calls/reasoning time unknown.
